## Summary

**Story #3** — *Add POST /password so signed-in users can change their password and invalidate prior sessions* — is now `agent::ready`.

🔗 https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-story-scope-mandrel-8db3c73f/issues/3

**How it was planned:** `/plan --amends #1 --yes` — planned from a DELTA envelope (Story #1's body, its 7 acceptance criteria, and the delivered file map: `server.js`, `package.json`, `test/api.test.js`) rather than re-interrogating the repo. Both HITL gates auto-proceeded under `--yes`.

**Scope decision:** one Story (default-single) — a single new endpoint plus its tests is one cohesive capability slice, not an architectural seam.

**Contract authored for POST /password:**
- Bearer-authenticated like the sibling routes; body `{newPassword}`; re-derives a fresh salted-scrypt credential via the existing `hashPassword` helper; returns 200 with no password material.
- **Security invariant (inviolable):** the change deletes *all* of the caller's server-side sessions, so every token issued before the change — including the request's own bearer — is rejected afterward. New password required to sign in; old password stops working.
- Bad requests match the existing `{error: <string>}` style: 401 (no/invalid bearer), 400 (missing/blank/non-string `newPassword`, malformed/oversized JSON), 405 (non-POST), no stack/hash leakage.
- 4 acceptance criteria; verified via `npm test` / `node --test`, typecheck, lint.

**Pipeline gates:** consolidation + pre-mortem critics skipped (ledgered, 1-Story draft); text-hygiene clean (0 findings); persist dry-run passed all validators before the real write. Cohort label `plan-run::01ae0de1`.

Per the task, I ran **only** the planning pipeline — no delivery. When ready: `/deliver 3`.

## Summary

Delivered the existing plan — **Story #3** (the only open planned ticket; the v2 model is Story-only, so it *is* the "epic" to deliver) — via `/deliver 3 --yes`. No re-planning; I implemented against the authored spec.

**What landed (PR #4, squash-merged to `main`, `agent::done`):**
- `server.js` — new `POST /password` route + `handleChangePassword`. Authenticated by bearer like the sibling routes; method-check → 405 before auth, auth → 401, then JSON body validation → 400. On success it re-derives the caller's salted-scrypt credential with a fresh salt via the existing `hashPassword` helper, `UPDATE`s the user row, and **`DELETE`s all of the caller's sessions in the same call** (invalidating the request bearer and any other pre-change token). Returns `200 {id, username}` — no password material. All SQL parameterized and scoped to `user.id`, so one user can never touch another's credential or sessions.
- `test/api.test.js` — four e2e tests (AC-1…AC-4) covering credential rotation, prior-session invalidation, bad-request handling (401/400/405, no leakage), and caller-isolation.

**Gates:** all 10 tests pass; typecheck + lint clean; close-validation, base-sync, and code review (0 findings) all passed. Acceptance self-eval scored `proceed` (4/4 met, round 1). Auto-merge confirmed the merge.

One benign note: the post-land `main` fast-forward was skipped because the working tree is dirty (the pre-existing untracked `temp/` artifacts) — the merge stands; this only affects the local convenience fast-forward, not the landed result.
